description: Hire one agent from the 5dive Marketplace onto the user's team, by its agent_id from marketplace_list. Hiring is free; the box's own limits apply. Check with the user before you hire.

agent_id.description: The agent's id from marketplace_list, e.g. theo.

name.description: Name for the new agent on the team (lowercase letters, digits, dashes). Leave out to use the agent's own.

name: agents_hire
